principles.principle: Counties are not interchangeable; strategy posture should be county-specific and source-cited.
Trusted local relationships are campaign infrastructure, not optional extras.
Fairs, festivals, civic clubs, courthouse spaces, and local radio/newspaper moments carry outsized trust value.
Election trust improves when process clarity, transparency, and lawful administration are emphasized.
